Exercise: Leg Pull-In

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- bilateral
- multi_joint

Primary Muscles:

- abdominals

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:

- bodyweight

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
ATP-PC system and glycolytic pathway

Recovery Time:
24 hours

Goals:

- core_strengthening
- abdominal_muscle_development

Contraindications:
None

Exercise Variations:

- name: Leg Pull-In with Resistance Band, equipment: resistance band

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Bicycle Crunches, equipment: body only
- exercise_name: Leg Raises, equipment: body only

Instructions:

- Lie on an exercise mat with your legs extended and your hands either palms facing down next to you or under your glutes. Tip: My preference is with the hands next to me. This will be your starting position.
- Bend your knees and pull your upper thighs into your midsection as you breathe out. Continue the motion until your knees are around chest level. Contract your abs as you execute this movement and hold for a second at the top. Tip: As you perform the motion, the lower legs (calves) should always remain parallel to the floor.
- Return to the starting position as you inhale.
- Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
